name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin
description: Bindex Maven Plugin is a Java 8 Maven plugin for running Machai Ghostwriter document-processing actions and generating structured Bindex metadata. The thread-safe bindex aggregator goal can run without a Maven project and scans a configured project or reactor, while bindex-per-module processes a Maven project module. It configures an org.machanism.machai.gw.processor.ActProcessor, supports interactive, parallel, and non-recursive workflows, and can load GenAI credentials and custom XML values from a matching Maven settings.xml server. The plugin integrates with Maven build automation and supports semantic discovery and GenAI-assisted integration of library metadata.

constructors.description: Creates the aggregator Maven mojo implementing the bindex goal. Maven instantiates and configures it when the goal is invoked.

examples.description: Install the plugin by adding this declaration to a Maven build's plugins section, configure the workflow and credentials, and invoke org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo with mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.0:bindex.

constructors.description: Creates the per-module Maven mojo implementing the bindex-per-module goal. Maven uses it when processing a project module.

examples.description: After installing and configuring the plugin, run this command in a Maven module or reactor to construct org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexPerModuleMojo and scan the module context.

features.name: bindex
features.description: Executes the thread-safe aggregator bindex goal. It initializes usage statistics, configures an ActProcessor, and runs the interactive document-scanning workflow. The goal is annotated with requiresProject=false, aggregator=true, and compile-plus-runtime dependency resolution.

examples.description: Install the plugin in the build, configure the scan root and provider/model properties, then run this command from the project or reactor root to generate Bindex metadata.

features.name: bindex-per-module
features.description: Executes the thread-safe, non-aggregating bindex-per-module goal for a Maven project. It configures the workflow and scans documents with compile-plus-runtime dependency resolution.

examples.description: Add the plugin to the module or parent plugin configuration, select the scan path, and run this command during a reactor build when each Maven module requires its own Bindex processing.

features.name: configureAndScan
features.description: Configures the supplied ActProcessor and executes document scanning. The configuration may include username, password, and custom XML values loaded from a matching Maven settings.xml server entry.

examples.description: Place this server entry in ~/.m2/settings.xml, configure the plugin to use the server identifier machai-genai, and invoke the bindex goal. org.machanism.machai.bindex.maven.BindexMojo.getConfiguration() transfers the matching server values before scanning.

examples.title: Generate Bindex metadata for a Maven project
steps: Install the component by adding org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.0 to the build plugins section or by invoking its fully qualified Maven goal.
Configure the scan root with -Dgw.path=src/site, select a provider/model with -Dgw.model, and optionally provide additional instruction locations with -Dgw.instructions.
If credentials are required, add a <server> entry with an id, username, and password to ~/.m2/settings.xml and configure -Dgenai.serverId to that id.
Run mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.0:bindex -Dgw.path=src/site -Dgw.model=openai:gpt-4o-mini -Dgenai.serverId=machai-genai from the project or reactor root.
Review the generated Bindex metadata and use it for semantic artifact discovery or GenAI-assisted integration.

examples.title: Process modules in a Maven reactor
steps: Install and configure the plugin in each module or in the parent pom.xml plugin configuration.
Configure -Dgw.path and -Dgw.model for the module documentation and provide the optional Maven settings server configuration.
Run mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.0:bindex-per-module -Dgw.path=src/site from the reactor root or bind the goal to a suitable lifecycle phase.
Review the Bindex metadata produced for each processed Maven module.
